about_the_game:
Obsidian Core Technologies: Freelance Miner’s Guide

Welcome, Freelancer, to Obsidian Core Technologies! As our newest hire, you’ve been dispatched to the mineral-rich planet of Planet-14416331, a volatile world brimming with natural resources. Your mission is to extract rare ores, amass a fortune, and receive some of that fortune for yourself! Dig deep (into your pockets) and upgrade your gear.

DIG

The most valuable ores are deep down.
Dig as deep as you can and extract the most valuable ores. Take them to the refinery and we will compensate you 0.035671% of the value of those ores. It is our mission to maintain fair pay for fair work.

UPGRADE

As you have brought your own drill rig, we have provided an outpost to facilitate use of your commission to further upgrade. Allowing you to reach deeper into the crust and extract ores that will be far more profitable to the company.

SURVIVE

At Obsidian Core Technologies, we prioritize your success in extracting the planet’s resources. Planet-14416331 has been meticulously surveyed to ensure optimal mining conditions. However, just in case minor inconveniences arise we’ve thoughtfully outfitted an Arms Dealer at your personal outpost. They offer a selection of tools and enhancements to safeguard your operations, ensuring you can focus on delivering valuable ores to our refineries.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Octa Core Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: IRONBORNE is a mining/bullet-hell adventure game. MINE. UPGRADE. FIGHT. Do you have what it takes to reach into the depths?
